    Who We Work With in the Treasure Valley

    Healthcare & Clinics

    Patient-area access, pharmacy and med-room control, and camera coverage that respects privacy zones.

    Schools & Districts

    Lockdown-ready entries, visitor management, and cameras for buildings, buses and parking lots.

    Manufacturing & Food Processing

    Perimeter and dock cameras, restricted-area access, and cabling for plant-floor networks.

    Property Management & Multi-Tenant

    Tenant card access, lobby entrance control, and one system across every building you manage.

    How a Project Runs

    From First Walkthrough to 24-Hour Support

    1. 01

      Free Site Assessment

      A senior technician walks the facility and documents coverage gaps, aging equipment and code exposure.

    2. 02

      Design & Proposal

      Camera layouts, door schedules and cabling plans, with clear phased pricing.

    3. 03

      Installation

      Installed, programmed and tested by our Boise team, with as-built documentation at turnover.

    4. 04

      Monitoring & Service

      24-hour local monitoring, remote support and service agreements that keep it all working.
